source: The floor any Office output should pass, whatever the task. The slide overflow estimate, the dark-on-dark rule and the formula issue types are ported from OfficeCLI (Apache-2.0, see THIRD_PARTY.md). Contrast ratios follow WCAG 2.2. FLOOR-PDFUA runs veraPDF, a separate optional tool, against PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1).

rules.text: The file uses at most two font families, resolved through runs, styles and the theme.
No text is estimated to overflow its slide shape, and no cell text or number is cut by its column or row.
Text with a set colour has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its set background, or 3:1 for large text.
Every formula carries a saved result and none is an error value.
The file has a title in its properties; slides have titles, pictures have alternative text, sheets are named and documents declare a language.
Exported as a tagged PDF, the file passes PDF/UA-1 in veraPDF. Skipped where the tool is absent; see checks/pdfua.py for the exporter findings left out.
